title: CAISO TH_ZP26_GEN-APND: day-ahead minus real-time by hour
subtitle: Mean spread for each local hour, 2026-08-28 to 2026-09-26, USD/MWh
source_line: Source: CAISO via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables caiso_dam_hub_prices, caiso_rtm_hub_prices; data retrieved to 2026-09-28.
citations: California Independent System Operator (CAISO). PRC_LMP: OASIS Locational Marginal Prices, day-ahead market (DAM). https://oasis.caiso.com/mrioasis/logon.do. Retrieved 2026-09-28 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table caiso_dam_hub_prices, data commit 2c667859235e.

California Independent System Operator (CAISO). PRC_INTVL_LMP: OASIS Interval Locational Marginal Prices, real-time dispatch (RTD, 5-minute). https://oasis.caiso.com/mrioasis/logon.do. Retrieved 2026-09-28 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table caiso_rtm_hub_prices, data commit 2c667859235e.
facts: CAISO TH_ZP26_GEN-APND, 2026-08-28 to 2026-09-26: the mean day-ahead minus real-time spread was highest in the hour starting 19:00 local, 11.9 USD/MWh, and lowest in the hour starting 06:00, 0.67 USD/MWh.
Mean spread over all hours, 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-26: 3.36 USD/MWh.
